content: The cosmos is within us. We are made of star-stuff. We are a way for the universe to know itself.
Somewhere, something incredible is waiting to be known.
Extraordinary claims require extraordinary evidence.
The first principle is that you must not fool yourself, and you are the easiest person to fool.
I would rather have questions that can't be answered than answers that can't be questioned.
Nothing in life is to be feared, it is only to be understood. Now is the time to understand more, so that we may fear less.

attribution: Charles Darwin, On the Origin of Species
content: There is grandeur in this view of life, with its several powers, having been originally breathed into a few forms or into one.
If I have seen further it is by standing on the shoulders of giants.
The most incomprehensible thing about the world is that it is comprehensible.
Imagination is more important than knowledge. Knowledge is limited. Imagination encircles the world.
An expert is a person who has made all the mistakes that can be made in a very narrow field.
What we observe is not nature itself, but nature exposed to our method of questioning.
The Analytical Engine weaves algebraical patterns just as the Jacquard loom weaves flowers and leaves.
Science and everyday life cannot and should not be separated.
What you do makes a difference, and you have to decide what kind of difference you want to make.
The good thing about science is that it's true whether or not you believe in it.
The great tragedy of science: the slaying of a beautiful hypothesis by an ugly fact.
In the fields of observation chance favours only the prepared mind.

attribution: Stephen Hawking, A Brief History of Time
content: The whole history of science has been the gradual realisation that events do not happen in an arbitrary manner.
The greatest enemy of knowledge is not ignorance, it is the illusion of knowledge.
A new scientific truth does not triumph by convincing its opponents, but rather because its opponents eventually die.
If you know you are on the right track, if you have this inner knowledge, then nobody can turn you off.
